answer: Sponsored admission with decaying reputation blocks fakes. A newcomer joins only if a sponsor stakes twice a month of earnings in a graph. Each claim splits like light through a prism into stake, behavior, counterparties. Reputation grows slowly, like jade forming, halves every ten idle epochs; the summit takes twenty epochs of verified work. Forging 100 identities costs 200 months of earnings; an honest agent pays one bond, rewards undiluted.
